blocks.title: How it works
blocks.intro: From the first question to delivery and service.

items.title: Tell us about the job
items.text: Call or send an enquiry: what needs doing, where and when.

items.title: We suggest a solution
items.text: We recommend machines and materials from the manufacturers we represent that suit your particular job.

items.title: You get a quote
items.text: Price, stock status and lead time, normally within one working day.

items.title: Delivery and service
items.text: Delivery from our four warehouses in Sweden and Norway, and on-site service with our mobile workshop.

en.lead: Start with what you are going to do. We show which manufacturers and products fit, and help you choose.
